Every y is the first-line baseline, with subsequent baselines separated by lineHeight. The supplied institution measurement at 56px gives a 45px ascent and 29px descent. Its corrected baseline y=210 includes the safe top of 150, the measured ascent of 45 and 15px clearance, placing the measured glyph bounds at y=165 to y=239. All other block geometry remains unchanged. The title is largest and the seven unchanged verse lines are arranged as two, two and three. The middle pair names the interval immediately above a broad unlettered band; that space belongs to the stanza rhythm, while the mother paper's horizontal and diagonal creases retain their scanned positions throughout the sheet. Below the interval, two longer lines narrow to the single word 'continue.', exposing the grain around the ending. The short colophon closes the literary field. Status and identity use the actual left anchor x=220. The identity field contains exactly four lines: 'Gual Wells'; 'Study 2026-10-23'; '06:39:01.611 UTC+08:00'; 'Mark 925d37e2fbfb88d6'.
